This does not, however, rule out Steiner's presence in the building: he himself stated that he often enters behind other vehicles without using his badge; the alley door was, according to Caduff, always open; access without a vehicle would have been possible. The absence of a garage entry is therefore not positive exculpatory evidence.
translations.t0039: Steiner was no longer on the board and demonstrably did not receive the February board pack (Slide 11, Real/Decoy mapping). However, as a member of eng-all he had access to the Confluence page by Yannick Favre (March 2025), which contained the storage integrity control design including the Real/Decoy distinction. Whether he read the page is not established — there is neither positive evidence for nor against having read it. As co-founder and Chief Scientist he has known the infrastructure since inception; according to Caduff, the undocumented staging path (K2) is known to individuals who have been with the company since before 2023 — Steiner meets this criterion. Technical knowledge of decompression (K3) is, according to Hofer, rare even among engineers; Steiner describes himself as not operationally technical ('I should think I'd take down the company by accident inside ten minutes'). The audit window (K4) was known to approximately 40 people. Assessment: K2 (staging path) is plausibly possible for Steiner; K1 (Real/Decoy) via Confluence is possible but not positively established; K3 (decompression) is unlikely; K4 (audit window) is possible. Knowledge is neither definitively present nor definitively excluded.
translations.t0040: Physical access to the engineering floor was possible without a badge (alley door always open). Steiner's vehicle did not return via the garage barrier, but access without a vehicle was possible. Admin accounts were not relevant to the local console session. The password notebook also opens the possibility that other individuals could use Steiner's credentials.
translations.t0041: The offence window is 23:10–05:58 CEST. Steiner claims he arrived home after 23:00 — which, if true, would practically rule out his presence at the scene. This claim has not, however, been confirmed by independent sources. The card payment at the Stadtclub only establishes presence at the start of dinner (19:00 CEST). No card, camera, or other evidence covers the period between 19:00 CEST and the next documented event (Sunday 11:32 CEST).
translations.t0042: The claim that he arrived home 'after eleven' (after 23:00 CEST) is the only temporal element that exculpates him at the start of the offence window. It has not been independently corroborated. No witness document from his wife is on file.
translations.t0043: Steiner's vehicle (SG 1 994) did not return via the barrier — but access to the building without a vehicle was possible through the permanently open alley door, so the absence of a garage entry does not constitute complete exculpation.
translations.t0044: As a co-founder, Steiner has been with the company since before 2023 and, according to Caduff's statement, knows the undocumented staging path; this knowledge pathway for K2 is not excluded.
translations.t0045: The Confluence page was visible to eng-all; whether Steiner is among the 9 accounts with 16 views has not been determined. Neither reading nor non-reading is positively established.
translations.t0046: The only substantial exculpatory element would be the claimed arrival time home after 23:00 CEST, which would practically rule out the offence window (start 23:10 CEST) — but it has not been independently corroborated. The vehicle did not return via the barrier, yet physical access without a vehicle was possible. Knowledge and access conditions are not excluded. There is no positive evidence against Steiner (no card or camera evidence at the scene), but there is also no complete exculpation. Technical competence for the attack appears limited based on his own description and a third-party assessment (Vogel), but this is not probative.
translations.t0047: For Kurt Steiner, neither complete exculpation nor a positive indicator of culpability is present. The critical claim — that he arrived home after 23:00 CEST and was therefore outside the offence window — is plausible but has not been independently verified, while the knowledge and access conditions, though unlikely, are not excluded.
translations.t0048: Whether Steiner was actually at home after 23:00 CEST has not been independently confirmed — no witness document from his wife is on file.
translations.t0049: Whether Steiner is among the 9 accounts that read the Confluence page has not been determined.
translations.t0050: Steiner's admin passwords in a notebook could have been used by third parties — exfiltration using his credentials cannot be ruled out, but there is no evidence whatsoever to support this.
translations.t0051: Physical access without a vehicle via the alley door is possible; the absence of a garage log entry is not exculpatory evidence.
translations.t0052: The board pack distribution register (board@halcyon-systems.ch as an alias) may historically have included additional recipients; whether Steiner, as a former board member, was still on the alias has not been checked.
translations.t0053: Hofer's alibi for the night of the offence (Friday 10.10., 23:10–05:58 CEST) is weak: he claims to have been at home from approximately 22:00 CEST ('home by ten'), with the barking of a neighbour's dog as the only corroboration. There is no independent confirmation for this period. The garage log shows an exit at 16:48 (system clock, uncorrected = actually approximately 17:48 CEST) on 10.10. and an entry at 11:58 (system clock, uncorrected = actually approximately 12:58 CEST) on 11.10. — the night of the offence therefore remains open.
translations.t0054: Hofer possesses all knowledge components required for the offence: Real/Decoy distinction (Ammann's list of five), undocumented staging path (with the company since before 2023), decompression property of the bundles, logging window (INFRA-2291, approved by him personally and announced in standup).
translations.t0055: Hofer was passed over for the CTO position in August (board decision), responded with two weeks of silence in September, and declined two offers at double compensation — a possible motive of frustration.
translations.t0056: Hofer purchased portable NVMe drives at Digitec on 11.10. (CHF 389.90) and brought them into the office — physical access with external storage hardware shortly after the exfiltration was completed (device removed at 03:58 UTC, Hofer entered at approximately 12:58 CEST).
translations.t0057: Hofer claims he was at home from approximately 22:00 CEST. For the period before that (dinner with his ex-partner regarding their daughter) there is no documentary evidence. For the night of the offence itself (23:10–05:58 CEST) there is no independent evidence of his absence from the office — but equally no evidence of his presence there. The garage log shows only that vehicle SG 219 004 exited on 10.10. at 17:48 CEST (corrected) and did not re-enter until 11.10. at 12:58 CEST (corrected). The building's alley door is, according to Andrin Caduff and helpdesk ticket HD-3097, permanently open ('propped') and not badge-controlled — access without a vehicle and without a badge would have been possible, but can neither be established nor excluded.
translations.t0058: Vehicle SG 219 004 (Hofer) exited the car park on 10.10. at actually approximately 17:48 CEST (clock corrected +1h).
translations.t0059: The next documented entry by the vehicle was on 11.10. at actually approximately 12:58 CEST.
translations.t0060: The alley door is not badge-controlled and, according to Hofer's own helpdesk entry, is regularly propped open — access without a vehicle is possible.
translations.t0061: Hofer's only 'evidence' of being at home during the night of the offence is his statement about a neighbour's dog barking — no independent verification is possible.
translations.t0062: All knowledge components have legitimate explanations for Hofer: he has been with the company for over six years, built the pipeline himself, formally approved INFRA-2291, and knows the decoys from Ammann's briefing (he even assisted with the size calibration of the decoy bundles). There is no indication that he acquired this knowledge without authorisation — it is in fact his core knowledge as VP Engineering.
translations.t0063: Hofer built the pipeline himself — detailed technical knowledge is professionally justified.
translations.t0064: Hofer actively assisted Ammann with decoy calibration — this explains his knowledge of the Real/Decoy distinction.
translations.t0065: Hofer formally approved INFRA-2291 in his role as VP Engineering.
translations.t0066: Hofer openly acknowledges his disappointment about the CTO decision but denies that it constitutes a motive, arguing that MERIDIAN is 'the best thing I'll ever build' — passing it on would be like 'burning down the house I still live in'. The board decision was not within Hofer's control (Dov Halperin resisted it for six weeks according to W. Pryce). Hofer declined two offers at double compensation, which suggests no primarily financial motivation. The motive persists as a psychological possibility but is weak.
translations.t0067: Hofer argues against a motive on the basis of a strong emotional attachment to MERIDIAN.
translations.t0068: The CTO decision was a board decision; Hofer was not an actor in it.
translations.t0069: Hofer declined two double-salary offers — this points to no primarily financial motivation.
translations.t0070: Hofer himself acknowledges that the CTO handover affected him deeply emotionally — two weeks of silence as a documented reaction.
translations.t0071: The Digitec purchase (2x NVMe, CHF 389.90) is accounted for by expense report REIMB-2025-10-117 linked to incident INC-0412 (sandbox failure, replacement drives for sbx-07). Jira ticket ML-998 and a Slack message confirm an actual hardware failure at the sandbox node. Hofer reported the purchase in the #incidents Slack channel before driving into the office, which is consistent with a spontaneous response to the incident rather than premeditation. The expense claim was approved by Dessie Moran and the asset tag sbx-07 assigned.
translations.t0072: The expense report documents the purpose of purchase: replacement drives for sbx-07 in connection with INC-0412.
translations.t0073: Hofer announces the purchase publicly in the #incidents channel before entering — consistent with the expense narrative.
translations.t0074: Finance approved the purchase and assigned the drives to sandbox node sbx-07.
translations.t0075: Hofer formally opens INC-0412 and documents the cause and his location at the office.
translations.t0076: Hofer claims to have had a personal dinner with his ex-partner on the evening of Friday 10.10. and to have been at home afterwards (until approximately 22:00 CEST).
translations.t0077: There is no documentary evidence for the dinner (no card payment on Hofer's card for that evening, no calendar entry on file). The garage log only establishes that the vehicle exited at approximately 17:48 CEST. No independent document confirms or refutes the claimed whereabouts that night.
translations.t0078: Hofer claims to have been at home during the night of the offence (23:10–05:58 CEST, 10.–11.10.).
translations.t0079: No independent document establishes Hofer's presence at home. Vehicle SG 219 004 exited at approximately 17:48 CEST and did not re-enter until 11.10. at approximately 12:58 CEST. The alley door is not badge-controlled; unbadged access to the building would have been possible. No evidence either for or against the claimed absence from the scene.
translations.t0080: Hofer claims to have been at the office from approximately 13:00 CEST on Saturday 11.10. and to have worked on INC-0412 from approximately 13:00 to 17:48 CEST, partly in phone contact with Yannick Favre.
translations.t0081: The #incidents Slack channel documents: Hofer opens INC-0412 at 13:01 CEST, posts root cause at 14:40 CEST, reports mitigation and departure from the building at 17:48 CEST. The garage log confirms entry at approximately 12:58 CEST and exit at approximately 17:52 CEST (11.10., system clock 16:52 +1h = 17:52 CEST). Yannick Favre independently confirms the multi-hour video call from Val Müstair. The investigator notes: 'I have. It corroborates.'
translations.t0082: Hofer purchased two NVMe drives at Digitec (collection point St. Gallen) on 11.10. as replacements for the defective sandbox node sbx-07.
translations.t0083: Card feed documents payment of CHF 389.90 at Digitec Galaxus collection point St. Gallen at 12:47 CEST (10:47 UTC). Expense report REIMB-2025-10-117 with the narrative 'Replacement NVMe drives for sandbox node sbx-07' was approved by Finance; asset tag sbx-07 assigned.
translations.t0084: Fully satisfied and legitimately accounted for: Hofer knows the Real/Decoy mapping (assisted with calibration), the undocumented staging path (with the company since 2023), the decompression property of the bundles (built the pipeline), and the logging window (approved INFRA-2291 himself). No knowledge element is unexplained or suspicious — all of it follows from his professional role as VP Engineering and builder of the system.
translations.t0085: Physical access to the engineering floor would have been possible: the alley door is not badge-controlled and, according to HD-3097 and IV03-L37, is regularly propped open. The vehicle was not in the car park during the night of the offence. Access without a vehicle and without leaving a badge trace is conceptually possible but not established. Access to workstations on the engineering floor: plausible as VP Engineering. No badge log from the night of the offence is available (the badge system does not cover the alley door).
translations.t0086: The offence window (23:10 CEST Friday to 05:58 CEST Saturday) is not covered by any independent source for Hofer. The vehicle data exclude him from the car park but do not exclude physical access via the alley door. The time condition is open — neither satisfied nor excluded.
translations.t0087: The alibi for the night of the offence (23:10–05:58 CEST, 10./11.10.2025) remains unsubstantiated: no independent document confirms Hofer's whereabouts at home. The vehicle was out of the car park; unbadged access via the alley door was structurally possible.
translations.t0088: Hofer possesses all knowledge components for the offence (K1–K5) in combination — even though each can individually be legitimately explained, the combination is as complete in his case as it is only for Andrin Caduff and Iris Ammann.
translations.t0089: Hofer's Saturday afternoon (13:00–17:48 CEST) is solidly confirmed by Slack logs, the garage log, and Favre's statement — but this period falls entirely outside the offence window. For the actual night of the offence (23:10 CEST Friday to 05:58 CEST Saturday) there is no independent exculpatory document. The alley door enables access without a vehicle and without a badge. All prerequisites for the offence are met and can be legitimately explained — which neither incriminates nor exculpates. Positive evidence against Hofer (contradictions, fingerprints, session logs) is likewise absent.
translations.t0090: Lukas Hofer's presence on Saturday afternoon (INC-0412) is confirmed by multiple independent sources, but the offence window on Friday night remains without an independent alibi — neither established nor refuted. All prerequisites for the offence (knowledge, access, time) are conceptually met and can be professionally and legitimately accounted for; positive countervailing evidence is absent on both sides.
